Definition: Elam, a son of Shem and his descendants, with their country; also of six Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Elam is a son of Shem and his descendants, with their country; also of six Israelites. In Genesis 10:22, the text says "Elam." The life behind the name is told on the Elam People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elam matters because God knows His people by name, and Elam is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
